items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: And reading all these Thad Jones arrangements and, you know, all that kind of stuff, and Brookmeyer charts

ctx.x: When you’re playing the harmonica, do you always know what notes you’re playing?

Yes. I visualize the harmonica as a piano keyboard. Since the harmonica is totally invisible when you play it – I mean you pick it up, you look at it, and it’s got a bunch of these little holes – the holes don’t tell you much. And as soon as you put it in your mouth it’s gone anyway. So when I first started playing, when I was 18, and I was playing in that Northwestern jazz band and learning what thirteenth chords were and everything like that, which I didn’t know before, it was like what the hell is this? And…
I just realized something. You just answered my question by saying that. Because I saw some of your videos where you were playing unison piano and harmonica lines.
